newsitem.title: UK: Midland Bank raises UK base rate.
newsitem.headline: Midland Bank raises UK base rate.

text.p: HSBC's Midland Bank said on Wednesday it would lift its base lending rate by one quarter point to 6.0 percent from Thursday.

The move follows a similar increase in official interest rates by the Bank of England, which was followed by immediate interest rate rises from National Westminster Bank, Royal Bank of Scotland and Barclays Bank.
Leading home loans goups Halifax Building Society, Abbey National and Woolwich Building Society have said they were leaving their mortgage rates unchanged.
